preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 10**4
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in (int(line) for line in stdin.split() if line.isdigit() and int(line) >= 2 and int(line) <= 2 * 10**5))
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 2 * 10^5) representing the number of vertices in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 for edges in (stdin.split() for _ in range(t)))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n-1 edges, each represented by two integers u and v (1 ≤ u, v ≤ n, u ≠ v).

preconditions.expression: all(u != v for u, v in (map(int, line.split()) for line in stdin.split() if not line.isdigit()))
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices u and v.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in (map(int, line.split()) for line in stdin.split() if not line.isdigit()))
preconditions.description: Each edge connects vertices within the valid range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.split()) == t for stdout in (stdout.strip() for _ in range(t)))
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one integer per test case, in the same order as the input.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(output) <= n for output in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each output is an integer representing the minimal number of leaves possible, within the valid range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all(int(output) == min_leaves_possible(adj_list) for adj_list, output in zip(parse_test_cases(stdin), stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the minimal number of leaves achievable by performing any number of valid operations on the tree.
